properties.description: **Essential** — Baseline hygiene for Guest Configuration: the non-negotiable controls every deployment should enforce from day one. This tier delivers RBAC and managed-identity controls eliminating shared credentials, TLS / HTTPS enforcement preventing in-transit interception, encryption-at-rest with service-managed keys, and key and certificate lifecycle hygiene (rotation, expiration, validity). Together these policies protect against credential theft, unencrypted data exposure, and accidental data loss.…
